mapper.select: /* TITLENAME:标题名(普通产品取产品名称 ,分级产品取 母产品名称+（子产品代码）) PRODNAME：【分级产品取“产品名称+子产品名称”；普通产品取“产品名称”】 PRODID：产品代码（普通产品取产品代码 ,分级产品取子产品代码） REGCODE：产品登记编码（普通产品取产品登记编码 ,分级产品取母产品登记编码） SETDATE：产品成立日期 */ select rpi.prod_id PRODID, case when rpi.IS_GRADE = '01' then rpi2.prod_name ||'（'||rpi.prod_id||'）' else rpi.prod_name end TITLENAME, case when rpi.IS_GRADE = '01' then rpi2.prod_name ||rpi.prod_name else rpi.prod_name end PRODNAME, rpi2.prod_re REGCODE, rpi.SET_DATE SETDATE, nvl(rpi2.prod_id,rpi.prod_id) PPRODID from rep_prod_info rpi /*查询普通产品或者母产品数据 p_prod_id:母产品代码：当为子产品时填写母产品代码。普通产品为自己的产品代码。母产品为空*/ left join rep_prod_info rpi2 on rpi.p_prod_id = rpi2.prod_id and rpi2.status = 'E' where rpi.prod_id = #{prodId} and rpi.status = 'E'

select * from ( SELECT to_char(open_start_date,'yyyy/MM/dd') ||'-'||to_char(open_end_date,'yyyy/MM/dd') OPENVDATE, to_char(operation_start_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') VDATE, to_char(auto_redeem_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') RDATE, HOLD_DAYS HOLDDAYS FROM dis_prod_plan where PROD_ID = #{pprodId} AND operation_start_date > #{endDate} order by operation_start_date ) where rownum <= 6
select nvl(UNIT_VALUE,0) VALUE,nvl(UNIT_VALUE_T,0) TOTALVALUE from REP_PROD_INDEX where prod_id = #{prodId} and value_date = #{lastWorkDay}
